home.title: Discover your next read without losing your place.
home.description: Browse curated recommendations and category shelves that stay ready for deeper discovery flows.
home.footer: Recommendations and categories stay available here while search, author browsing, and book details build on the same discovery contract.

categories.description: Jump into domain categories before refining results.

recommendations.description: Fresh discovery cards based on the approved recommendation mode.

popularAuthors.description: Browse notable authors from the current public catalog without translating their domain content.

empty.title: Nothing to show yet
empty.description: This section is available, but no items matched the current response.

error.title: This section could not be loaded
error.description: Refresh or retry this route to request the discovery data again.

stale.description: Showing the last successful response while newer data is unavailable.

books.title: Search, filter, and bookmark the next shelf you want to revisit.
books.description: The result set stays tied to the URL so refresh and navigation keep the same discovery context.

category.title: Browse one category without losing your filter context.
category.description: This route keeps the selected category fixed while minimum rating and page state remain bookmarkable.

author.description: Browse one author's catalog without collapsing the author summary into the book grid.
author.booksDescription: The first page is ready on entry, then additional pages append below the same author summary.

empty.title: No books are available for this author yet
empty.description: This author page loaded successfully, but the current catalog does not list any books here yet.

invalidId.title: This author link is invalid
invalidId.description: Use a positive author ID to open a localized author catalog.

notFound.title: This author could not be found
notFound.description: The author ID is valid, but the public catalog does not have a matching author page.

error.title: This author page could not be loaded
error.description: Retry the same route to request the author catalog again.

loadMore.errorTitle: More books could not be loaded
loadMore.errorDescription: Retry to append the next page for this author without resetting the summary.

criteria.title: Active criteria
criteria.fallback: Showing all books for the current route.

loading.title: Loading books
loading.description: Booky is preparing the current result set.

empty.title: No books matched this route
empty.description: Adjust the search text, category, or minimum rating and try again.

error.title: This result set could not be loaded
error.description: Retry the same route to request the discovery data again without losing the current URL state.

stale.description: Showing the previous result set while Booky loads the latest response.
